notes: Leapmotor launched in Australia in 2024 via its Stellantis distribution partnership. As of September 2026 the brand sells three distinct BEV model lines: the B10 small SUV (2 BEV variants), the C10 medium SUV (2 BEV variants), and the B05 small hatchback. EXCLUDED (non-BEV): the B10 Hybrid EV (EREV/range-extender, launched mid-2026 from $37,888 excl. ORC), the C10 Hybrid EV (EREV, launched 2025; known as 'Hybrid EV' locally, it is a range-extender plug-in hybrid with claimed total range ~1,150 km). Neither EREV variant is a BEV and both are omitted. The B05 is confirmed for AU (five-star ANCAP rating announced August 2026, priced from $35,990 driveaway) but only driveaway pricing is currently confirmed; pre-ORC MSRP and full technical specifications were not verified in sources reviewed and several fields are null. The C10 Style retains the older 400V architecture and 6.6 kW AC charging; the MY26 C10 Design LR upgraded to 800V with 11 kW AC and 180 kW DC. Towing for the C10 Style (1,500 kg braked) is confirmed via Carsales spec data; towing for the C10 Design LR (MY26) and B10 variants has not been separately confirmed for the 2026 spec and is marked as low confidence where populated. The official Leapmotor Australia website (leapmotor.net) returned minimal indexable content; specifications have been sourced from Carsales, CarExpert, Zecar, and CarSorted (which states it sources from the Leapmotor AU website).
